## - Setting work directories
  
Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
options(future.globals.maxSize= 891289600*200)
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#710D10', '#A21317', brew_mix[1:8], '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

# 2. Loading integrated protein single cell object

```{r}
OUT_MERGED <- file.path(local_wd_folder, 'results/integrated/DNA_Integrated.rds')
combined_dna_pro <- qs::qread(OUT_MERGED)
```

# 3. Plotting panel 3D

```{r}
# ── Highlight barcodes: PT17 cells carrying BRAF_G466A_Het ───────────────────
highlight_barcodes <- rownames(
    combined_dna_pro@meta.data %>%
        filter(Donor == 'PT17') %>%
        filter(Clone == 'BRAF_G466A_Het')
)

cat("Highlighted cells:", length(highlight_barcodes), "\n")

library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(combined_dna_pro, "umap"))

umap_df$barcode <- rownames(umap_df)
umap_df$Highlighted <- umap_df$barcode %in% highlight_barcodes

stopifnot(sum(umap_df$Highlighted) == length(highlight_barcodes))   # every barcode matched a UMAP row

# Split into two layers so highlighted cells are guaranteed on top regardless
# of row order — a single shuffled layer can't promise that.
df_bg <- umap_df[!umap_df$Highlighted, , drop = FALSE]
df_fg <- umap_df[ umap_df$Highlighted, , drop = FALSE]

# Single highlight colour (Erythroblast's colour, reused here as a plain
# highlight colour, not a cell-type mapping) with a DARKENED outline —
# darken, not lighten, so the highlighted points' edges stay visible
# against each other and against the grey background, matching the
# contrast fix used in the other UMAP scripts.
highlight_fill  <- "#8CD17D"
highlight_color <- darken(highlight_fill, amount = 0.5)

# Background: uniform grey fill AND grey outline — kept visually flat/
# neutral so it reads purely as context. No stroke on the background at
# all (stroke = 0), so only highlighted cells carry a visible outline.
bg_fill  <- "grey85"
bg_color <- "grey85"   # same as fill => effectively no visible outline

p <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
    # Background: all non-highlighted cells, small, flat grey, no stroke.
    geom_point(
        data   = df_bg,
        shape  = 21,
        size   = 2,
        stroke = 0,
        alpha  = 0.6,
        fill   = bg_fill,
        color  = bg_color
    ) +
    # Foreground: highlighted cells only, larger, single distinct colour,
    # with a real stroke (only these get an outline at all).
    geom_point(
        data   = df_fg,
        shape  = 21,
        size   = 4,
        stroke = 0.6,
        alpha  = 0.95,
        fill   = highlight_fill,
        color  = highlight_color
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

save_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "Fig_3D.pdf"),
    plot = p, width = 5.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "Fig_3D.png"),
    plot = p, width = 5.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# 83% plasma cells
```

# 4. Plotting figure S7

